messages.text:
Hello. Just wondering what delivery service will bring the miner to my
residence.

Hello,

It depends on where you are. Orders go out from the warehouse that serves your region, the US, Canada or our Netherlands warehouse for Europe and the UK, and the carrier is picked at the label stage. In practice that is usually UPS, FedEx, DHL or the local postal service for smaller units. Tracking is emailed to you as soon as the label is made, so you will know the carrier then.

If you tell me the country and postcode, I will say which one it is likely to be.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
Thank you for your reply. I live in Canada Ontario postal code ····
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page

Hello,

Thanks for that. (postal code ····) is served by our Canadian warehouse in Brampton, so your unit ships domestically. Nothing crosses a border, which means no duties or customs charges on delivery.

For a unit the size of the Thor P2, the label is almost always UPS, with Canada Post as the fallback on some rural routes. The warehouse picks whichever is quicker to your address on the day, and the tracking email tells you which one it ended up being.

Happy to help with anything else on the Thor P2.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hello William,

Happy to help. If anything else comes up on the Thor P2, power draw, noise, pool setup, just reply here and I will sort it.

You are also welcome in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where our technical lead JD and plenty of other owners hang out. It is a good place to see the units running before you commit.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
